name: False Religions
overview: Scripture warns believers to reject false religions that lead to idolatry and deception, as seen in the command against making graven images (Exodus 20:4) and the rise of false prophets who deceive many (Matthew 7:15; 24:11). The consequences of turning away from God's truth include destruction and judgment, highlighted in Hosea 4:6 where rejection of knowledge results in being cut off. Jeremiah 5:30 underscores the grave corruption present in the land when God's law is forgotten, emphasizing the need for vigilance and adherence to the true faith revealed in Christ.
